source.check: names read from the Portadown Times page image, which lists the members returned unopposed by name and address but not by division; each is placed in the division he or she held in 1958, or (the six new members) in the division of the member the Portadown News says he replaced; returned unopposed, no poll

note: Triennial election of the county council, 1961: nominations closed 16 May 1961; 21 of the 22 seats returned unopposed and one contest, Crossmaglen, polled 1 June 1961. The unopposed list prints no party labels. Returned unopposed. Patrick D. Fearon: no party label printed in 1961. At other elections he stood as Nationalist (Camlough, Newry No. 2 Rural District, 5 June 1958, printed 'N.': Newry Telegraph, 24 May 1958, p. 1 ("The Council Elections: Newry No. 2 (Co. Armagh) Rural District Council (nominations)"); Newry Reporter, 22 May 1958, p. 1 ("Newry No. 2 Area (nominations)")).
